thread:
maya: Quick sync — quantization integration for the GA model is slipping. Lee said there's a runtime regression in the 4-bit path. Need to map downstream impacts and decide whether we cut scope, ship fallback, or move GA date. @lee can you share the blocker ETA? :eyes:

lee (ENG-ML): ETA ~ 5 business days to stabilize kernels unless we accept a 10-15% perf hit. Root cause is memory aliasing on 4-bit matmul. I pushed a test patch but it regresses seq-len 2048 perf.

andrew (ENG-PLATFORM): If we accept the perf hit we can still meet GA but throughput SLO will be lower for heavy customers. We should quantify cost delta. @tim any infra impacts for a temporary slower kernel?

tim (ENG-SRE): No infra risk. We might need extra Dedicated slots during peak to keep latency SLOs; that is a capacity bill though. I can rough-cost it if we decide to go that route.

zoe (CUSTOMER-SUCC): Heads-up from BD — two pilot customers (FinSys & HealthCo) expect GA features for Q2. HealthCo has compliance gating on private deployment; they prefer pushing date over degraded perf. FinSys will accept slower perf if we give explicit quotas.

maya: Ok can we sketch the options and owners quickly? I'm trying to update the Q2 roadmap and OKRs tonight. Propose: A) Wait for fix (5d) -> shift GA by 1 week; B) Ship with 4-bit perf hit + capacity bump -> keep GA; C) Ship 8-bit fallback only -> partial feature set.

sophia (DESIGN): Option C means we hide feature toggles for customers on 8-bit fallback and clearly surface degraded metrics in the console. PM should own messaging.

lee (ENG-ML): Confirming A is safest. B is risky because we haven't stress-tested the slower kernel at scale. C is doable quickly but requires extra engineering to route models to 8-bit path and add flags — estimate 3 days to implement routing and flags.

andrew (ENG-PLATFORM): Routing + flags (C) is highest-confidence to keep date and avoid extra infra spend. I can own rollout and canary if @tim helps with traffic shaping.

maya: Cool. Can we get a quick decision: does product prefer C (partial surface, keep date) or A (delay + full perf)? Need to lock this by EOD to update OKRs and marketing.

zoe: From CS, customers prefer timeline clarity. For HealthCo, they'd accept delay. For FinSys, they'd sign Q2 commit if we promise explicit quotas and fallback plan. So C with explicit quotas + opt-in sounds ok.

tim (ENG-SRE): I can do canary + throttling for C. If we go that route, I need routing flags live by tomorrow morning to create canary rules.

maya: Decision: go with C — implement 8-bit fallback routing + user-facing toggle and quota promises. Owners: Lee -> 8-bit routing (3d), Andrew -> rollout/canary (2d), Tim -> canary rules + infra regen (1d), Sophia -> UI messaging (1d), Maya -> customer comms and OKR update. I'll update roadmap doc and push new milestone sequencing.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary rollout job created for product/canary at 2024-05-14T03:00Z by andrew

maya: Thanks all — I'll post the revised milestone timeline in the roadmap doc and tag follow-ups. Please ping if estimates slip. :thumbsup:
